app.name: Tilawah
app.tagline: Listen to the Quran, pick up where you left off
app.description: Stream all 114 surahs from hundreds of reciters. Resume where you stopped, build playlists and listen offline.

search.empty: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a surah number or another spelling.

home.title: What would you like to listen to?
home.continueEmpty: Surahs you start will wait for you here, at the second you stopped.

reciters.title: Reciters
reciters.subtitle: {count} reciters, each with one or more recitations
reciters.loadError: Reciters couldn’t load. Check your connection and reload the page.
reciters.notFound: This reciter isn’t in the catalogue anymore.

surahs.title: Surahs
surahs.subtitle: All 114 surahs. Choose one to hear it from any reciter.
surahs.notFound: There are 114 surahs. This number isn’t one of them.

player.label: Audio player
player.empty: Choose a surah to start listening
player.error: This recitation couldn’t play. Try again, or pick another reciter.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: {count, plural, one {# surah} other {# surahs}} from {reciter}

player.shortcuts: Space plays or pauses, arrow keys skip 10 seconds, M mutes

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Everything here is saved on this device.
library.noFavoriteReciters: Tap the heart on a reciter’s page to keep them here.
library.noFavoriteSurahs: Favorite a surah from any surah list to find it quickly.

history.empty: Surahs you play will be listed here.

playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.deleteDescription: This removes the playlist from this device. The recitations themselves aren’t affected.
playlists.empty: Create a playlist, then add surahs from any reciter’s page.
playlists.emptyPlaylist: This playlist is empty. Add surahs from a reciter’s page.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.empty: Download surahs from their menu to listen without a connection.
downloads.confirmDescription: The file is {size} and will be stored on this device for offline listening.
downloads.unknownSize: The file size isn’t known yet, so it could be large.
downloads.lowStorage: Your device is low on storage. This download may fail.
downloads.failed: The download didn’t finish. Check your connection and try again.
downloads.unsupported: This browser can’t save audio for offline use.

stats.title: Listening stats
stats.subtitle: Counted only while audio is playing, on this device.
stats.streakHint: A day counts once you listen for a minute.
stats.noData: Start a surah and your listening time will show up here.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Back up favorites, playlists, progress and stats, or move them to another browser.
data.importError: That file isn’t a Tilawah backup.
data.resetDescription: Favorites, playlists, history, resume points and stats will be erased from this device. Downloads are kept.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.description: This page isn’t saved on your device. Your downloaded surahs still play.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: The page hit an error. Try again, and if it keeps happening, reload.
errors.notFoundDescription: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

playerPage.title: Player
playerPage.subtitle: Every control in one place. Pick a reciter and listen straight through all 114 surahs.
playerPage.nothingPlaying: Nothing is playing yet. Pick a reciter, then play all 114 surahs or start from any one of them.
playerPage.chooseReciterDescription: Every reciter here has all 114 surahs.
